item.title: Landscape as Witness: A Remembrance reflection
item.description: Take a rare look inside St James' chapel to discover the wartime stories of local people and embrace a moment of calm. Pause in the gardens at our Avenue of Remembrance to reflect on the relationship between landscape, memory and human connection.
item.location: Wentworth Castle Gardens, Barnsley, South Yorkshire

item.title: Pooch Passport Explorers
item.description: Embrace the crunchy leaves and frosty mornings this Autumn and Winter with your pooch pal by your side. Complete your pooch passport with ten stamps to claim your reward. A paw-fect way to enjoy the great outdoors together.
